documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Management reported a strong first quarter for FY27 with record revenue, EBITDA, and PAT, outperforming the broader two-wheeler industry production growth. The company successfully operationalized a captive solar plant in Haryana and expects another in Rajasthan to be commissioned in Q2 FY27. Management also revised its full-year growth guidance upward to high teens and increased its projected capex to approximately Rs. 700 crore to accommodate new orders. ASK Automotive Limited reported its financial and operational performance for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, achieving consolidated revenue of Rs.

guidance.claim: The company revised its full-year growth guidance to high teens.
guidance.quote: We are confident that we will continue to grow not only in mid-teens, but we will be now growing for the full year in high teens.

guidance.claim: Management guided for a 20% increase in exports for the year.
guidance.quote: Last year, we could not go near the target anywhere, but this time, we have given a guidance of 20% increase in the exports, and at the moment, we are still very confident we'll achieve it.

guidance.claim: The company is confident of growing around mid-teens in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are confident that will continue to grow around mid-teens in FY27.

guidance.claim: Alloy wheel revenue is expected to be around Rs. 90 to Rs. 100 Cr in FY27.
guidance.quote: FY27 we are expecting revenue of around Rs. 90 - Rs. 100 Cr and FY28 will be about Rs. 220 Cr.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic demand remains robust and private consumption is resilient.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic demand remains robust, private consumption is resilient, and the Government of India's structural reforms, particularly GST 2.0, continue to energize the broader economy and, importantly for us the automobile sector, given its deep forward and backward linkages.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains optimistic on the medium-term industry outlook supported by improving consumer sentiment.
demand_outlook.quote: We also remain optimistic on the medium-term industry outlook, supported by improving consumer sentiment, expected benefits from the 8th Pay Commission, and continued policy support for manufacturing and formalization through labor reforms.

demand_outlook.claim: The two-wheeler industry closed FY26 with a strong production volume of 26.7 million units.
demand_outlook.quote: The two-wheeler industry closed FY26 with a strong production volume of 26.7 million units, up from 23.9 million units in FY25.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains optimistic that the geopolitical situation shall normalize soon and sector growth trajectory will be maintained.
demand_outlook.quote: We still remain optimistic that the geopolitical situation shall normalize soon, and the growth trajectory of our sector shall be maintained.

demand_outlook.claim: Independent aftermarket grew by 24.7% in FY26.
demand_outlook.quote: Happy to share that our independent aftermarket has grown by 24.7% in FY26.

demand_outlook.claim: OEM customers are carrying on with their original production schedules.
demand_outlook.quote: As far outlook of the two-wheeler industry is concerned, our all our OEM customers they are carrying on with their original production schedules which shows a nice growth in this year also and none of the supplies have been affected by the raw materials or anything.

capex_expansion.claim: The 9.9-megawatt solar power plant at Sirsa, Haryana is fully operational.
capex_expansion.quote: I am happy to update that our 9.9-megawatt solar power plant at Sirsa, Haryana has been fully operational and is delivering the sustainable operational economies on the expected lines.

capex_expansion.claim: The second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatts at Bikaner is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatts at Bikaner, Rajasthan is ready and is expected to be commissioned in Q2FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Management announced plans to urgently set up a new plant in the South, located in Bangalore.
capex_expansion.quote: That is the need that we have to urgently set up for the new orders that have come. We have to set up a new plant in South, that will be in Bangalore at a war footing, and we hope to operationalize it before March in this financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company operationalized a 9.9 MWp Solar Power Plant for captive consumption.
capex_expansion.quote: 9.9 MWp Solar Power Plant for captive consumption operationalized.

capex_expansion.claim: The company needs to invest around Rs. 400 Cr for next year's growth.
capex_expansion.quote: For next year growth of mid-teens, we need to invest around RS.400 Cr which we shall be investing in this year also.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for FY27 is projected to be about Rs. 400 Cr.
capex_expansion.quote: FY27 we'll be spending about Rs. 400 Cr.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA margin stood at 12% in Q1 FY27.
Overall margins are expected to be around 13.5% to 14%.
margins_costs.quote: The overall margins you will be finding at around 13.5% to 14% in between that.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated net revenue grew by 30% year-on-year in Q4 FY26 excluding certain impacts.
margins_costs.quote: Excluding pass-through impact of significant increase in aluminium prices on revenue, which was 8% and wheel assembly business strategic reduction, which was negative 2.7%, overall, our net revenue has grown by 30% on year-on-year basis.

margins_costs.claim: Q4 FY26 EBITDA reached Rs. 140 Cr with 31.1% year-on-year growth.
margins_costs.quote: We achieved EBITDA of Rs. 140 Cr with 31.1% year-on-year growth.
EBITDA margin at 12.1%, however, this EBITDA percentage was impacted due to pass-through alloy prices as mentioned earlier.

margins_costs.claim: Full year FY26 EBITDA reached Rs. 551 Cr with 24.1% year-on-year growth.
margins_costs.quote: We achieved EBITDA of Rs. 551 Cr with 24.1% year-on-year growth.

margins_costs.claim: Full year FY26 EBITDA margin was 13.1%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin at 13.1%, however, EBITDA percentage was impacted due to pass-through alloy prices.

orders_capacity.claim: Confirmed orders for alloy wheels are about Rs. 70 crore to Rs. 90 crore for the current financial year and about Rs. 250 crore for next financial year.
orders_capacity.quote: We have confirmed orders of about Rs. 70 crore to Rs. 90 crore depending on how the customer gear up for this financial year. However, for next financial year, we have confirmed orders of about Rs. 250 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: Karoli plant capacity utilization increased from 60%-65% to about 75%.
orders_capacity.quote: happy to share that against the installed capacity in Karoli plant, from 60% to 65% that we were in the last quarter, we have now gone up to about 75%, and we are confident that in the last Q4, we will be around 80% of the capacity utilization, because we see the visibility for the Q4.

orders_capacity.claim: Bangalore plant is running at near optimum capacity utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: Our Bangalore plant, which was our 18th plant, is running at near optimum capacity utilization

orders_capacity.claim: Bangalore plant capacity utilization has reached 90%.
orders_capacity.quote: Very, very happy to share that Bangalore we have reached 90% capacity utilization that we set up last year, our 18th plant and the third plant in Bengaluru.

orders_capacity.claim: Karoli plant capacity utilization is currently at 65%.
orders_capacity.quote: In the Karoli plant, the capacities utilization is still 65%, that is the reason that we have made investment for the alloy wheels.

capital_allocation.claim: Internal accruals will be sufficient, but external financing will be used for cash flow management.
capital_allocation.quote: We are actually keeping in mind our high mid-teen growth, our internal accruals will be sufficient; but yes, for cash flow management, we will have to take some external financing.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that term loans will be taken for machinery.
capital_allocation.quote: We will be taking term loan for machines.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's philosophy is to completely plow back internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: The philosophy of the company is to completely plow back the internal accruals.

capital_allocation.claim: The board has recommended a dividend of 92.5%, amounting to Rs. 1.85 per equity share.
capital_allocation.quote: The board has recommended a dividend of 92.5%, that is Rs. 1.85 per equity share of face value of Rs. 2 each.

capital_allocation.claim: Internal accruals and free cash will be ploughed back into the company.
capital_allocation.quote: All these internal accruals free cash will be ploughed back in the company, so we will see to it even the debt levels are contained within the limits.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflict in West Asia created undue volatility in energy, commodity, and currency markets.
risks_headwinds.quote: As you are aware, after 28th February 2026, the geopolitical conflict in West Asia had created undue volatility in energy, commodity, and currency markets, and had led to a sharp, phenomenal increase in aluminum alloy prices, which affected our industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflict in West Asia has disrupted the global economy and affected the Indian economy.
risks_headwinds.quote: After 28th February, 2026, geopolitical conflict in West Asia has disrupted the global economy, posing an unprecedented challenge in supply chain, creating undue volatility in energy, commodity and currency across the globe and it has started affecting Indian economy as well.

risks_headwinds.claim: Export revenue was impacted by trade disruptions, higher tariff rates, geopolitical tensions, and logistics issues.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our revenue from exports were at Rs. 141 Cr in FY26 against Rs. 147 Cr last year because of the trade disruptions due to higher tariff rates, geopolitical tensions, supply chain issues, logistic costs and other bottlenecks.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to operationalize the new plant in Bangalore before March in the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We have to set up a new plant in South, that will be in Bangalore at a war footing, and we hope to operationalize it before March in this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects profitability in the AISIN JV to improve by the end of this year quarter.
management_commitments.quote: We are also expecting that by the end of this year quarter, we'll see some profitability there.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects its second captive solar plant in Bikaner to be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatt in Bikaner, Rajasthan is progressing well and is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27, this reflects ASK's special focus on green energy.

management_commitments.claim: Wheel assembly revenue will be nil starting from April 1, 2026.
management_commitments.quote: From 1st April 2026, wheel assembly revenue will be nil.

management_commitments.claim: Real growth in FY27 will be 4% higher than the published growth on a year-on-year basis.
management_commitments.quote: On year-on-year comparison in FY27 also, our real growth will be 4% higher than the published growth on year-on-year basis.

management_commitments.claim: The company is confident of growing around mid-teens in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We are confident that will continue to grow around mid-teens in FY27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
